patches.name: p6-funky-brass
patches.notes: THE Prophet brass — Dave Smith's signature sound through the P5/P6 lineage. OSC 1 + 2 SAW slightly detuned, OSC 2 +0 to +5 cents, filter cutoff ~50% with snappy env amount, fast attack on amp, medium decay. The stab that defined synthpop brass. Range c2-c6. Used in: modern synthwave, The Weeknd 'Blinding Lights' brass tones, '80s nostalgia productions.

patches.name: p6-insane-lead
patches.notes: Singing analog lead with portamento — the Prophet scream. SAW + SQUARE mix, filter cutoff 60-70%, resonance 30%, env amount HIGH, glide ON ~30%. Mod wheel patched to filter cutoff for expression. Range a2-a5. Used in: modern prog, Mac Miller leads, contemporary R&B solos.

patches.name: p6-synth-bass
patches.notes: Punchy poly bass — OSC 1 SAW 16', OSC 2 SQUARE 8' detuned slightly, sub osc on, filter cutoff 30%, snappy env. The fattest, most direct analog bass on a modern synth. Range a1-a3. Used in: synthwave, modern funk, Mura Masa-era productions.

patches.name: p6-crystal-pad
patches.notes: Slow-attack lush pad — two detuned saws, slow attack (~800ms), wide filter cutoff (~85%), low resonance, built-in chorus engaged. Range c2-c6. Used in: ambient sections, film scoring, modern dream-pop production.

patches.name: p6-sequencer-pluck
patches.notes: Plucky sequencer line — short envelope (A=0, D=300ms, S=0, R=0), SQUARE wave, filter cutoff 50% with mod env, glide off. Designed to drive the P6's built-in step sequencer. Range c3-c6. Used in: synthwave sequences, Tycho-style productions, modern minimal techno.

patches.name: p6-classic-strings
patches.notes: Analog string ensemble — two SAW oscs octave-stacked, slow attack (~600ms), full sustain, chorus on full. The OBX/Prophet strings every '80s synth pad chases. Range c2-c6. Used in: synthwave pads, modern soundtracks, Stranger Things-era nostalgia.

patches.name: p6-acid-squelch
patches.notes: P6 acid — proves the modern analog can squelch. OSC 1 SAW, filter cutoff 30%, resonance HIGH (~70%), env amount maxed, fast decay. Range a1-a4. Used in: modern acid house, Floating Points-era productions, IDM bass leads.

patches.name: p6-house-stab
patches.notes: Short chord stab — SAW + SQUARE, very short envelope (~150ms decay), high filter env amount, no sustain. Built-in distortion engaged for grit. Range c3-c5. Used in: modern deep house, Disclosure-era stabs, jackin' UK productions.

patches.name: p6-wide-lead
patches.notes: Wide unison lead — both oscs SAW, max detune via fine tune knob, sub osc on, filter cutoff 70%, low resonance. Mod wheel sweeps filter for expression. Range a2-a5. Used in: modern progressive house leads, Tycho melodies, Bonobo lead lines.

patches.name: p6-ambient-pad
patches.notes: Slow-evolving atmospheric pad — supersaw-ish detune, very slow attack (2sec+), LFO patched to filter cutoff (slow triangle), built-in REVERB + DELAY drenched. Range c2-c6. Used in: ambient electronica, Floating Points pad work, soundtrack beds.

patches.name: p6-fm-bell
patches.notes: Cross-mod metallic bell — OSC 2 → OSC 1 frequency modulation (P6's X-MOD knob up), short percussive envelope, slight reverb. Synth-bell character that's harder/grittier than DX7. Range c3-c6. Used in: modern electronic productions, IDM melodic textures.

patches.name: p6-sub-drone
patches.notes: Held sub drone — OSC 1 TRIANGLE 32', filter wide open, no envelope movement, sub osc on. The deepest, cleanest analog sub you can get from a modern poly. Range a0-a2. Used in: dub productions, ambient sub layers, modern trap sublayers.
